examples.text_en: He is a snob who cares only about money.
examples.text_zh: 他是个势利的人，只在乎钱。

examples.text_en: The old snob looked down on the poor family.
examples.text_zh: 那个老势利眼看不起这户穷人家。

examples.text_en: A deep snowdrift blocked the road to the village.
examples.text_zh: 一个深深的雪堆挡住了通往村子的路。

examples.text_en: The wind made a snowdrift near the old house.
examples.text_zh: 风在旧房子旁堆起了一个雪堆。

examples.text_en: Every snowflake looks different from all the others.
examples.text_zh: 每片雪花都与众不同。

examples.text_en: A single snowflake fell onto her open hand.
examples.text_zh: 一片雪花落在她张开的手上。

examples.text_en: The snowstorm closed every school in the whole town.
examples.text_zh: 这场暴风雪让全镇的学校都停课了。

examples.text_en: We stayed at home during the heavy snowstorm.
examples.text_zh: 暴风雪很大，我们待在家里。

examples.text_en: She did not mean to snub her old friend.
examples.text_zh: 她并不是有意冷落老朋友。

examples.text_en: He felt the snub for many days after that.
examples.text_zh: 在那之后很多天，他都为这次冷落而难受。

examples.text_en: The little house felt warm and snug in winter.
examples.text_zh: 这间小屋在冬天里温暖又舒适。

examples.text_en: She wore a snug coat that kept her warm.
examples.text_zh: 她穿着一件贴身的暖和外套。

examples.text_en: The child began to snuggle close to her mother.
examples.text_zh: 孩子开始偎依在母亲身边。

examples.text_en: They snuggle under a warm cover every night.
examples.text_zh: 他们每晚都偎依在温暖的被子里。

examples.text_en: That so-called expert gave us the wrong answer.
examples.text_zh: 那位所谓的专家给了我们错误的答案。

examples.text_en: This so-called friend never came to help me.
examples.text_zh: 这个所谓的朋友从没来帮过我。

examples.text_en: She had to soak the dry beans all night.
examples.text_zh: 她得把干豆子泡上一整夜。

examples.text_en: The rain will soak through your old shoes.
examples.text_zh: 这场雨会湿透你的旧鞋子。

examples.text_en: The soaring bird slowly left the ground below.
examples.text_zh: 那只高飞的鸟慢慢离开了下方的地面。

examples.text_en: Prices were soaring and no one could stop it.
examples.text_zh: 物价飞涨，谁也无法阻止。

examples.text_en: After many hard years he returned to sobriety.
examples.text_zh: 经历了多年艰难岁月后，他重新戒了酒。

examples.text_en: Her sobriety gave the whole family new hope.
examples.text_zh: 她戒酒让全家人有了新的希望。

examples.text_en: Many writers of that time wrote about socialism.
examples.text_zh: 那个时代的许多作家都写过关于社会主义的文章。

examples.text_en: He studied socialism during his years at college.
examples.text_zh: 他在大学期间研究过社会主义。

examples.text_en: The lamp would not work in that old socket.
examples.text_zh: 那盏灯在那个旧插座上不亮。

examples.text_en: He put the plug into the wall socket.
examples.text_zh: 他把插头插进了墙上的插座。

examples.text_en: The workers laid fresh sod across the new field.
examples.text_zh: 工人们在新场地上铺上了新鲜的草皮。

examples.text_en: They cut the sod into small even pieces.
examples.text_zh: 他们把草皮切成了大小均匀的小块。

examples.text_en: His sodden coat was heavy with the cold rain.
examples.text_zh: 他那件湿透的外套被冷雨浸得沉甸甸的。

examples.text_en: The sodden ground gave way under our feet.
examples.text_zh: 湿透的地面在我们脚下陷了下去。

examples.text_en: The girls played softball in the park after school.
examples.text_zh: 放学后女孩们在公园里打垒球。

examples.text_en: He broke his finger during a softball game.
examples.text_zh: 他在一场垒球比赛中弄断了手指。

examples.text_en: Warm water will soften the hard dry bread.
examples.text_zh: 温水会把又干又硬的面包泡软。

examples.text_en: Her voice began to soften as she spoke.
examples.text_zh: 她说话时声音渐渐柔和下来。

examples.text_en: The softness of her voice made him feel calm.
examples.text_zh: 她声音的柔和让他感到平静。

examples.text_en: He loved the softness of the old wool coat.
examples.text_zh: 他喜欢那件旧羊毛外套的柔软。

examples.text_en: Pine is a softwood that is easy to cut.
examples.text_zh: 松木是一种容易切割的软木材。

examples.text_en: Most cheap tables are made from softwood.
examples.text_zh: 大多数便宜的桌子都是软木材做的。

examples.text_en: The soggy bread was no good for the children.
examples.text_zh: 泡软的面包对孩子们来说没法吃。

examples.text_en: We walked home over the soggy wet ground.
examples.text_zh: 我们走过湿漉漉的地面回家。

examples.text_en: They made a short sojourn in the old town.
examples.text_zh: 他们在那座老城里短暂地逗留了一番。

examples.text_en: His sojourn in the south lasted many long years.
examples.text_zh: 他在南方的旅居持续了漫长的许多年。

examples.text_en: She found solace in music after the sad news.
examples.text_zh: 听到那伤心的消息后，她在音乐中找到了安慰。

examples.text_en: His only solace was the love of his family.
examples.text_zh: 他唯一的安慰就是家人的爱。

examples.text_en: He used solder to join the two metal wires.
examples.text_zh: 他用焊接剂把两根金属线接在一起。

examples.text_en: The solder must be hot before you start.
examples.text_zh: 开始之前，焊接剂必须先加热。

examples.text_en: The whole room fell into a solemn silence.
examples.text_zh: 整个房间陷入一片庄严的沉默。

examples.text_en: He made a solemn promise to his old father.
examples.text_zh: 他向年迈的父亲郑重许下承诺。

examples.text_en: The solemnity of the moment touched everyone there.
examples.text_zh: 那一刻的庄严打动了在场的每个人。

examples.text_en: They spoke with great solemnity about the past.
examples.text_zh: 他们极其严肃地谈论着过去。

examples.text_en: Our solicitor read the whole paper out loud.
examples.text_zh: 我们的律师把整份文件大声读了一遍。

examples.text_en: She asked her solicitor for help with the house.
examples.text_zh: 她就房子的事向律师求助。

examples.text_en: The nurse was solicitous about every small need.
examples.text_zh: 护士对每一个细微的需要都很关心。

examples.text_en: He seemed solicitous for the health of his mother.
examples.text_zh: 他似乎很关心母亲的健康。

examples.text_en: Her solicitude for the old man was easy to see.
examples.text_zh: 她对那位老人的关心显而易见。

examples.text_en: He showed great solicitude about my long journey.
examples.text_zh: 他对我的长途旅行表现出极大的关切。

examples.text_en: The cold air will solidify the warm liquid.
examples.text_zh: 冷空气会使温热的液体凝固。

examples.text_en: Their friendship began to solidify over the years.
examples.text_zh: 多年来，他们的友谊渐渐巩固。

examples.text_en: The young soloist played before a large crowd.
examples.text_zh: 这位年轻的独奏者在众多观众面前演奏。

examples.text_en: She became a famous soloist with the city band.
examples.text_zh: 她成了市乐队的著名独奏者。

examples.text_en: In the end the problem was easy and solvable.
examples.text_zh: 最终这个问题很简单，是可以解决的。

examples.text_en: He believed that every such question was solvable.
examples.text_zh: 他相信每个这样的问题都是可以解决的。

examples.text_en: Water is a common solvent in many homes.
examples.text_zh: 水是许多家庭里常见的溶剂。

examples.text_en: He used a strong solvent to clean the wall.
examples.text_zh: 他用一种强效溶剂清洗墙壁。

examples.text_en: The doctor spoke about somatic pain and its cause.
examples.text_zh: 医生谈到了身体上的疼痛及其原因。

examples.text_en: Somatic feelings are those of the body.
examples.text_zh: 身体的感受就是身体本身的感受。

examples.text_en: The room was somber on that cold wet day.
examples.text_zh: 在那个阴冷潮湿的日子里，房间显得昏暗。

examples.text_en: He wore a somber face at the whole meeting.
examples.text_zh: 整个会议期间他脸色阴沉。

examples.text_en: The somnolent child could not keep his eyes open.
examples.text_zh: 那个想睡的孩子睁不开眼睛。

examples.text_en: Warm air made the whole class somnolent.
examples.text_zh: 暖融融的空气让全班都昏昏欲睡。

examples.text_en: He wrote a sonnet about her beautiful eyes.
examples.text_zh: 他写了一首关于她美丽眼睛的十四行诗。

examples.text_en: The teacher read an old sonnet to the class.
examples.text_zh: 老师给全班读了一首古老的十四行诗。

examples.text_en: His sonorous voice filled the whole great hall.
examples.text_zh: 他洪亮的嗓音充满了整个大厅。

examples.text_en: The bell gave a deep and sonorous sound.
examples.text_zh: 钟发出深沉而洪亮的声音。

examples.text_en: Black soot covered the wall above the old fire.
examples.text_zh: 黑色的煤烟盖住了旧火炉上方的墙壁。

examples.text_en: They cleaned the soot from the tall stone building.
examples.text_zh: 他们清除了那座高大石头建筑上的煤烟。

examples.text_en: He gave the child a sop of dry bread.
examples.text_zh: 他给孩子一片干面包。

examples.text_en: The sop was so wet it fell apart.
examples.text_zh: 那块泡软的东西太湿了，都散开了。

examples.text_en: His whole argument was only a clever sophism.
examples.text_zh: 他的整套论证不过是巧妙的诡辩。

examples.text_en: They saw through the sophism in his long talk.
examples.text_zh: 他们看穿了他长篇讲话里的诡辩。

examples.text_en: The old sophisticate had seen much of the world.
examples.text_zh: 这位久经世故的人见识过世间许多事。

examples.text_en: He played the sophisticate at every city party.
examples.text_zh: 在每场城市聚会上他都装成老于世故的样子。

examples.text_en: Her clothing showed a quiet and simple sophistication.
examples.text_zh: 她的衣着透出一种低调的老练。

examples.text_en: He moved through the city with easy sophistication.
examples.text_zh: 他从容而老练地穿行在这座城市里。

examples.text_en: The whole speech was full of empty sophistry.
examples.text_zh: 整篇演讲充满了空洞的诡辩。

examples.text_en: Few people were fooled by his clever sophistry.
examples.text_zh: 很少有人被他巧妙的诡辩骗到。

examples.text_en: The long talk had a soporific effect on us.
examples.text_zh: 那场冗长的讲话让我们昏昏欲睡。

examples.text_en: His soporific voice soon put the baby to sleep.
examples.text_zh: 他催眠般的嗓音很快让宝宝睡着了。

examples.text_en: Her sopping coat left water on the floor.
examples.text_zh: 她湿透的外套在地板上留下了水。

examples.text_en: He came in with sopping wet shoes and hair.
examples.text_zh: 他浑身湿透地走进来，鞋子和头发都在滴水。

examples.text_en: The old story is full of magic and sorcery.
examples.text_zh: 这个古老的故事充满了魔法和巫术。

examples.text_en: They believed that sorcery could change the weather.
examples.text_zh: 他们相信巫术能改变天气。

examples.text_en: She gave him a long and sorrowful look.
examples.text_zh: 她久久地、悲伤地看了他一眼。

examples.text_en: The sorrowful song made everyone in the room quiet.
examples.text_zh: 那首悲伤的歌让房间里的每个人都安静下来。

examples.text_en: They built a soundproof room for the loud music.
examples.text_zh: 他们为喧闹的音乐建了一间隔音室。

examples.text_en: The walls are thick and soundproof in this building.
examples.text_zh: 这栋楼的墙壁又厚又隔音。

examples.text_en: She likes to souse the fish in salt water.
examples.text_zh: 她喜欢把鱼浸在盐水里。

examples.text_en: A wave helped souse his whole new coat.
examples.text_zh: 一个浪头把他崭新的外套全浸湿了。

examples.text_en: The small town lies in the southeast of the country.
examples.text_zh: 这座小镇位于该国的东南部。

examples.text_en: They drove southeast for most of the long day.
examples.text_zh: 漫长的白昼里，他们大部分时间都朝东南方向开车。

examples.text_en: The birds flew southwards as the cold came.
examples.text_zh: 寒冷来临时，鸟儿朝南飞去。

examples.text_en: They walked southwards along the wide river.
examples.text_zh: 他们沿着宽阔的河岸向南走去。

examples.text_en: He grew up in the southwest of the old country.
examples.text_zh: 他在这个古老国家的西南部长大。

examples.text_en: A dry wind came from the southwest that night.
examples.text_zh: 那天夜里，一阵干燥的风从西南方吹来。

examples.text_en: The space shuttle came back to earth this morning.
examples.text_zh: 航天飞机今天早上返回了地球。

examples.text_en: We watched the space shuttle leave the ground.
examples.text_zh: 我们看着航天飞机离开地面。

examples.text_en: He used spackle to fill the holes in the wall.
examples.text_zh: 他用抹墙粉把墙上的洞填平。

examples.text_en: The spackle dried hard before we could paint.
examples.text_zh: 抹墙粉在我们刷漆前就干硬了。

examples.text_en: Every spangle on her dress caught the light.
examples.text_zh: 她裙子上的每片亮片都映着光。

examples.text_en: The night sky was full of bright spangles.
examples.text_zh: 夜空里满是闪闪发亮的小光点。

examples.text_en: The horses moved at a spanking pace down the road.
examples.text_zh: 马匹沿着大路飞快地前行。

examples.text_en: A spanking fresh wind came off the cold sea.
examples.text_zh: 一阵清爽的疾风从寒冷的海上吹来。

examples.text_en: He was sparing with his words at the meeting.
examples.text_zh: 在会上他说话很节约。

examples.text_en: She is sparing in the use of hot water.
examples.text_zh: 她用水很节省。

examples.text_en: Use the salt sparingly or the food will be bad.
examples.text_zh: 盐要少放，否则食物会不好吃。

examples.text_en: He spent his money sparingly during the long trip.
examples.text_zh: 长途旅行中他花钱很节省。

examples.text_en: The two men began sparring in the open field.
examples.text_zh: 两个人在空地上开始对打。

examples.text_en: Their sparring was only for fun and sport.
examples.text_zh: 他们的对打只是为了娱乐和运动。

examples.text_en: The trees were sparse on that high dry ground.
examples.text_zh: 在那片高而干燥的土地上，树木很稀疏。

examples.text_en: Only a sparse crowd came to the early show.
examples.text_zh: 早场演出只来了稀稀落落的观众。

examples.text_en: The old town is sparsely settled these days.
examples.text_zh: 如今这座老镇人口稀少。

examples.text_en: Small houses stood sparsely along the wide road.
examples.text_zh: 小房子稀疏地散布在宽阔的路旁。

examples.text_en: The room was plain and Spartan but very clean.
examples.text_zh: 房间简朴艰苦，却非常干净。

examples.text_en: They lived a Spartan life in the cold hills.
examples.text_zh: 他们在寒冷的山中过着简朴的生活。

examples.text_en: His work was spasmodic and never really complete.
examples.text_zh: 他的工作断断续续，从未真正完成。

examples.text_en: A spasmodic pain came and went all night.
examples.text_zh: 一阵阵的疼痛持续了一整夜。

examples.text_en: They had a small spat about the dirty dishes.
examples.text_zh: 他们为脏盘子起了点小口角。

examples.text_en: The two friends had a spat and stopped talking.
examples.text_zh: 两个朋友吵了一架，就不再说话了。

examples.text_en: A spate of new books came out that year.
examples.text_zh: 那年一下子出了大量新书。

examples.text_en: A spate of bad news hit the small town.
examples.text_zh: 一连串坏消息打击了这座小镇。

examples.text_en: The child has a good sense of spatial relations.
examples.text_zh: 这孩子有很好的空间关系感。

examples.text_en: Spatial thinking helps us move through a new city.
examples.text_zh: 空间思维帮助我们在新城市里认路。

examples.text_en: The fish left their spawn among the warm stones.
examples.text_zh: 鱼把卵产在温暖的石头间。

examples.text_en: The river was full of spawn in early spring.
examples.text_zh: 早春时河里满是鱼卵。

examples.text_en: She works in a specialized part of the hospital.
examples.text_zh: 她在医院里一个专门的部门工作。

examples.text_en: This tool is specialized and not easy to use.
examples.text_zh: 这件工具很专门，不容易使用。

examples.text_en: He specifically asked for the old brown book.
examples.text_zh: 他明确地要那本旧的棕色书。

examples.text_en: The rule was written specifically for small business.
examples.text_zh: 这条规定是专门为小企业写的。

examples.text_en: The whole specification was written on one long page.
examples.text_zh: 整个规格都写在一张长页上。

examples.text_en: They built the wall to that exact specification.
examples.text_zh: 他们按照那份确切的规格砌了这堵墙。

examples.text_en: Please tell me the specifics of the whole plan.
examples.text_zh: 请把整个计划的细节告诉我。

examples.text_en: We spent the meeting on the specifics of the deal.
examples.text_zh: 我们把会议时间花在了这笔交易的细节上。

examples.text_en: The scientist kept a rare specimen in the room.
examples.text_zh: 科学家把一件稀有标本保存在房间里。

examples.text_en: This stone is a fine specimen of its kind.
examples.text_zh: 这块石头是其种类中很好的标本。

examples.text_en: His specious argument sounded true but was not.
examples.text_zh: 他那似是而非的论证听起来有理，其实站不住脚。

examples.text_en: They were fooled by a specious and empty promise.
examples.text_zh: 他们被一个似是而非的空洞承诺骗了。

examples.text_en: There was not a speck of dust on the table.
examples.text_zh: 桌上连一点灰尘都没有。

examples.text_en: A small speck of food fell onto his coat.
examples.text_zh: 一点食物碎屑落到了他的外套上。

examples.text_en: The old building failed spectacularly in the strong wind.
examples.text_zh: 那座旧建筑在强风中轰然倒塌。

examples.text_en: She sang spectacularly and the whole room stood up.
examples.text_zh: 她唱得极为精彩，全场都站了起来。

examples.text_en: The old story tells of a pale specter at night.
examples.text_zh: 这个古老的故事讲的是夜里一个苍白的幽灵。

examples.text_en: Fear of war was a specter over the whole land.
examples.text_zh: 对战争的恐惧像幽灵一样笼罩着整片土地。

examples.text_en: The scientists studied the spectra of many distant stars.
examples.text_zh: 科学家们研究了许多遥远恒星的光谱。

examples.text_en: Their spectra were quite different from one another.
examples.text_zh: 它们的光谱彼此差别很大。

examples.text_en: The spectral light came from an old broken lamp.
examples.text_zh: 那奇异的光来自一盏破旧的灯。

examples.text_en: A spectral figure stood at the end of the hall.
examples.text_zh: 一个幽灵般的身影站在走廊尽头。

examples.text_en: The full spectrum of colors filled the wide sky.
examples.text_zh: 完整的色谱布满了广阔的天空。

examples.text_en: These problems cover a wide spectrum of human life.
examples.text_zh: 这些问题涵盖了人类生活的广阔范围。

examples.text_en: His answer was only a speculative guess about the past.
examples.text_zh: 他的回答只是对过去的一种推测性猜测。

examples.text_en: The book is speculative and full of open questions.
examples.text_zh: 这本书带有推测性质，满是悬而未决的问题。

examples.text_en: He studies speleology and knows many deep caves.
examples.text_zh: 他研究洞穴学，熟悉许多深洞。

examples.text_en: Speleology took her into the dark world below.
examples.text_zh: 洞穴学把她带进了地下的黑暗世界。

examples.text_en: The spendthrift lost all his money in one year.
examples.text_zh: 这个挥霍的人一年之内就败光了所有的钱。

examples.text_en: Her brother is a spendthrift who never saves.
examples.text_zh: 她弟弟是个从不存钱的浪费者。

examples.text_en: The plant has long spiky leaves and small red flowers.
examples.text_zh: 这株植物长着细长的尖叶和红色小花。

examples.text_en: His hair was short and spiky after the cut.
examples.text_zh: 剪过之后他的头发又短又尖刺。

examples.text_en: A bad fall hurt his spinal cord last winter.
examples.text_zh: 去年冬天一次重摔伤了他的脊髓。

examples.text_en: The doctor checked her spinal health with care.
examples.text_zh: 医生仔细检查了她脊柱的健康状况。

examples.text_en: The spindly young tree could not stand the wind.
examples.text_zh: 这棵细长的小树经不住风。

examples.text_en: Long spindly legs carried the small bird quickly.
examples.text_zh: 细长的腿带着小鸟飞快地跑。

examples.text_en: The spined animal moved slowly over the stones.
examples.text_zh: 这种有刺的动物在石头上慢慢移动。

examples.text_en: A spined plant can hurt your bare hand.
examples.text_zh: 有刺的植物会划伤你赤裸的手。

examples.text_en: Everyone called him spineless for never saying no.
examples.text_zh: 因为他从不敢说不，大家都叫他没骨气。

examples.text_en: The spineless creature lay still on the wet ground.
examples.text_zh: 这只无脊椎的生物静静地趴在湿地上。

examples.text_en: An old spinet stood in the corner of the room.
examples.text_zh: 房间角落里立着一台旧的小型古钢琴。

examples.text_en: She played a slow song on the small spinet.
examples.text_zh: 她用那台小钢琴弹了一首慢歌。

examples.text_en: The spiny plant grew along the dry stone wall.
examples.text_zh: 这种多刺的植物沿着干燥的石墙生长。

examples.text_en: He stepped back from the spiny bushes near the road.
examples.text_zh: 他从路旁多刺的灌木旁退开了。

examples.text_en: The church spire stood high above the small town.
examples.text_zh: 教堂的尖塔高高矗立在小镇上方。

examples.text_en: From the spire we could see the whole valley.
examples.text_zh: 从尖塔上我们能看见整个山谷。

examples.text_en: The splashy colors on her dress caught every eye.
examples.text_zh: 她裙子上的斑驳色彩吸引了所有人的目光。

examples.text_en: His shoes left splashy marks on the clean floor.
examples.text_zh: 他的鞋子在干净的地板上留下了斑驳的湿痕。

examples.text_en: The doctor said his spleen was a little large.
examples.text_zh: 医生说他的脾脏有点大。

examples.text_en: He was in a bad spleen all that long day.
examples.text_zh: 那一整天他都情绪很坏。

examples.text_en: The splendor of the old hall took our breath away.
examples.text_zh: 那座古老厅堂的壮丽让我们惊叹不已。

examples.text_en: They spoke of the splendor of the great city.
examples.text_zh: 他们谈起这座伟大城市的辉煌。

examples.text_en: He had to splice the two broken wires together.
examples.text_zh: 他必须把两根断掉的电线接起来。

examples.text_en: A good worker can splice the ropes in minutes.
examples.text_zh: 熟练的工人几分钟就能把绳子接好。

examples.text_en: The doctor put a splint on his broken arm.
examples.text_zh: 医生给他的断臂打上了夹板。

examples.text_en: A thin wooden splint held the plant straight.
examples.text_zh: 一根薄木片把植物撑直了。

examples.text_en: They decided to splurge on a fine long trip.
examples.text_zh: 他们决定奢侈一回，去一趟美好的长途旅行。

examples.text_en: It was a rare splurge for the whole family.
examples.text_zh: 这对全家人来说是一次难得的挥霍。

examples.text_en: Cold rooms stop the spoilage of food in summer.
examples.text_zh: 冷藏室能防止食物在夏天变质。

examples.text_en: Bad weather led to heavy spoilage of the crops.
examples.text_zh: 恶劣的天气导致庄稼大量损坏。

examples.text_en: A spokesman for the company spoke to the press.
examples.text_zh: 公司的一位发言人向媒体发了言。

examples.text_en: The spokesman gave a short answer and left.
examples.text_zh: 发言人简短地回答后便离开了。

examples.text_en: The ground was soft and spongy after the rain.
examples.text_zh: 雨后地面又软又像海绵一样。

examples.text_en: This old bread feels spongy and a little wet.
examples.text_zh: 这旧面包摸起来像海绵，还有点湿。

examples.text_en: Her singing was full of life and spontaneity.
examples.text_zh: 她的歌声充满活力和自然。

examples.text_en: The whole game had a happy spontaneity about it.
examples.text_zh: 整场比赛透着一种快乐的自发气息。
